Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As you know, the Product Support and Customer Education teams merged last month, and I'm organizing a two-hour workshop to help us establish effective working relationships. I want to make sure we get the logistics right, so I'd like to do our routine planning check-in before I finalize anything.

We have two possible workshop slots: October 9th from 1:00 to 3:00 PM, or October 10th from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM. The workshop can be conducted in person with a remote participation option, or entirely in person. Jordan and Priya are possible facilitators, and I'll be making the final arrangements.

Could each of you let me know about any relevant commitments, access needs, or process requirements you have so I can factor those into my planning? Thanks!
